marker_area_rule: s = 1.8 sqrt(N) pt^2; N counts model-specific RES files; no optimization weights
colour: Truncated Plasma [0,0.88]; logarithmic extracted molecule molar mass
callout_selection: Replace hypothetical/unestablished examples with recognizable experimentally characterized compounds. This is an illustrative selection, not descriptor-space farthest-point sampling.
molecular_rendering: VMD-inspired matte/chalky ball-and-stick with true ray-traced ambient occlusion; 1800x1200 white-background PNGs at 600 dpi; vector map and text
molecular_renderer: Tachyon 0.99b6 CPU ray tracer (the renderer used by VMD)
geometry_scope: Callouts show the same extracted dataset representatives used in the embedding. Experimental references establish the compound crystal identity, not observation of the selected predicted packing or conformer.
